claims.statement: The company might reach an INR2,000 crores borrowing by the end of the year to manage capex.
claims.quote: So we might go to an INR2,000 crores borrowing by the end of the year, but that is all going towards managing capex.
claims.speaker: management
claims.horizon: by the end of the year

claims.statement: The internal ambition or number for store expansion CAGR is 15%.
claims.quote: the internal number or internal ambition that we will look at will be that 15% number.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: Frontline store employees such as cashiers, packers, and shop assistants are non-permanent, while store and department managers are permanent.
facts.quote: So the frontline employees in the store, which are largely the cashiers and the packers and the shop assistants, are all non-permanent. The management employees, which are the department managers, store managers, and all that, are permanent.

facts.statement: The company maintains a project execution pipeline of the next two to three years of stores to be opened.
facts.quote: suffice to say that as of now, we are sitting on a project execution pipeline of next two to three years of stores that we will open

facts.statement: Stores that are used for SSSG calculation are those more than two years old.
facts.quote: the SSSG that we disclose is for stores more than two-years-old.
